projects.title: Unity Sports Club Dashboard
projects.description: A modern, responsive dashboard for sports club management with multi-role support, interactive tables, and full CRUD functionality.
projects.longDescription: A full-featured sports club management dashboard built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Supports Admin, Staff, Player, Manager, and Umpire roles with features like team & player management, tournaments, matches, results, blogs, and dynamic tables. Demonstrates advanced frontend development practices, reusable components, and optimized state management.
features: Multi-role management (Admin, Staff, Player, Manager, Umpire) with CRUD operations
Dynamic tables with sorting, filtering, pagination, and responsive design
Reusable forms and modals with validation and rich text editor support
Theme switching (Light/Dark/System), loading skeletons, and error handling
learnings: Advanced React patterns (component composition, hooks, HOCs, custom hooks)
Performance optimization (code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization)
Building reusable components (Form inputs, Buttons, Cards, Modals, Tables)
Writing clean and modular code with proper folder structure
Error handling and loading states for better UX
Polished, fully responsive UI across devices
Advanced data fetching and state management with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query

projects.title: Unity Sports Club Backend API
projects.description: A scalable RESTful backend API for managing a sports club, built with Express, TypeScript, and MongoDB, handling 100+ endpoints and 18 data models.
projects.longDescription: This backend powers the Unity Sports Club system, supporting multiple user roles and full CRUD operations for teams, players, tournaments, matches, venues, and blogs. Features modular routers, reusable middlewares, secure authentication, file uploads to Cloudinary, and optimized database queries for performance and scalability.
features: 100+ RESTful API endpoints for users, teams, players, tournaments, matches, venues, and blogs
18 fully designed and interconnected Mongoose data models
Role-based access control for Admin, Staff, Player, Manager, and Umpire
Reusable error-handling middleware and consistent API responses
File upload handling using Multer and Cloudinary integration
Distributed modular routers for each resource (user, tournament, match, team, venue, etc.)
Full CRUD operations with input validation and secure authentication using JWT
Optimized queries and database operations for performance at scale
challenges: Managing and structuring a large-scale backend with 18 data models and 100+ endpoints
Implementing reusable middleware for error handling, authentication, and file uploads
Ensuring security and role-based access control across multiple endpoints
Designing modular routers for maintainability and scalability
Optimizing MongoDB queries for large datasets
Integrating Cloudinary for media uploads efficiently
learnings: Building large-scale RESTful APIs with Express and TypeScript
Structuring backend projects with distributed routers and modular code
Advanced Mongoose schema design and database optimization
Implementing reusable middleware for error handling and authentication
Handling file uploads to cloud storage (Cloudinary) securely
Designing APIs that scale with complex relationships and multiple user roles

projects.title: Unity Arena
projects.description: A dynamic, responsive public-facing landing page for the sports club, showcasing live stats, tournaments, teams, and news.
projects.longDescription: This landing page provides fans and visitors with an interactive, fast-loading experience to follow tournaments, view team and player profiles, check live scores, and read news updates. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Aceternity UI, it leverages React Query for efficient data fetching and state management, ensuring real-time updates and smooth UX.
features: Dynamic display of tournaments, matches, and upcoming events
Team and player profiles with relevant stats
Live scores and standings using React Query for real-time data fetching
Responsive and polished UI using Tailwind CSS and Aceternity UI components
Performance optimization with lazy loading and code splitting
challenges: Fetching and displaying live data efficiently using React Query
Ensuring seamless performance and fast page loads
Designing a responsive and engaging UI for mobile and desktop
Integrating Aceternity UI components consistently with Tailwind CSS
learnings: Advanced data fetching and caching with React Query
Building responsive landing pages with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
Integrating pre-built UI component libraries (Aceternity UI) into custom design
Performance optimization techniques for modern frontend apps
